name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: Reusable Claude Code harness extracted from DevDigest: a Spec Driven Development workflow, a read-only researcher, an architecture reviewer and the engineering skills they share.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared engineering skills: React, Next.js, testing, Fastify, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Zod, TypeScript, architecture, security, Mermaid.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: A read-only researcher agent that answers one concrete question with evidence from the repository or official sources.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: A read-only architecture reviewer that checks a diff against the repository's own architecture rules.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec Driven Development: spec -> plan -> implement -> verify -> review, with guards, a run-plan orchestrator and a workflow retrospective.
